briefing: Markets rallied strongly today, with the NASDAQ up 2.7% and the S&P 500 up 2.3%. That is the kind of clear risk-on day our past lessons say to act on. We have about $446 in cash and 3 open slots, so we're putting it into VSAT, the strongest candidate with every buy signal confirmed. All 7 existing positions stay as they are, and their automatic stop-losses and profit targets remain in place.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier assets like growth stocks, which pushes the major indexes up sharply. Today both the NASDAQ and the S&P 500 rose more than 2%, a clear risk-on signal. Disciplined traders often hold spare cash through quiet days and put it to work on days like this, when the overall market is moving in their favor.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 所謂「風險偏好」（Risk-On）市況，是指投資者信心充足，願意將資金投向增長股等較高風險的資產，帶動主要指數顯著上揚。今日納指及標普500指數均升逾2%，正是典型的風險偏好訊號。有紀律的交易者往往在市況平淡時保留現金，待大市氣氛轉強、形勢有利時才果斷入市。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose broadly today: the NASDAQ gained 2.7% and the S&P 500 gained 2.3%, so investors were clearly willing to take on risk. The candidate list shows strength across many areas, including semiconductors (AMD, ALAB, MXL), satellite and communications stocks (VSAT, ASTS, VIA), infrastructure builders (STRL) and large-cap tech (AMZN), so the rally was not confined to one sector. No news headlines were provided for this session, so this summary is based only on price action and technical signals, not on any specific news story.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面走高，納指升2.7%，標普500指數升2.3%，反映市場風險胃納明顯回升。從候選名單可見，升勢遍及多個板塊，包括半導體（AMD、ALAB、MXL）、衛星及通訊股（VSAT、ASTS、VIA）、基建工程股（STRL）以及大型科技股（AMZN），並非單一板塊獨撐大市。由於今日未有提供相關新聞標題，以上分析純粹根據股價走勢及技術指標，並非引述任何特定新聞。

trades.reasoning: VSAT is the top-scoring candidate with all four confirmation signals: RSI of 64.2 in the bullish zone, a bullish MACD crossover, price well above its 20-day average and a volume surge that points to institutional buying, all on a strong risk-on day.
